# My Jewish Learning

> A comprehensive digital platform for learning about Jewish traditions, prayers, holidays, and rituals with live community events and guided spiritual practices.

My Jewish Learning, operated by 70 Faces Media, provides accessible Jewish education through articles, guides, online classes, prayer services, and community events. The platform covers everything from daily Talmud study and prayer practices to holiday observances and grief support, serving Jews of all denominations and backgrounds.

## Key Topics

- Jewish Prayer & Liturgy
- Kaddish & Mourning Rituals
- Torah & Talmud Study
- Jewish Holidays
- Jewish Denominations
- Shiva & Bereavement
- Minyan & Community Prayer
- Passover Observance
- Rosh Hashanah & Yom Kippur
- Daf Yomi
- Hebrew Prayers
- Jewish Traditions
- Religious Education
- End-of-Life Care
- Jewish Healing Practices

## Core Learning & Events

- [My Jewish Learning - Judaism & Jewish Life | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com): Homepage for Jewish learning resource covering holidays, rituals, Torah, and traditions
- [Upcoming Events | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/the-hub): Calendar of upcoming online classes, prayer services, and community events
- [Daf Yomi | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/article/daf-yomi): Guide to daily Babylonian Talmud study with email subscription option

## Prayer Guides & Liturgy

- [The Shema | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/article/the-shema): Reference guide to the Shema daily prayer from Deuteronomy
- [Guide to Jewish Holiday Prayers | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/article/guide-to-jewish-holiday-prayers): Guide to prayers for Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, and High Holiday observances
- [Jewish Prayer for the Sick: Mi Sheberach | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/article/mi-sheberakh-may-the-one-who-blessed): Guide to Mi Sheberach healing prayer for the sick in synagogue
- [Blessings for Food & Drink | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/article/blessings-for-food-drink): Reference to Jewish blessings including Hamotzi for food and drink
- [Tefilat Haderech, The Traveler's Prayer | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/article/tefilat-haderekh-the-travelers-prayer): Guide to Tefilat Haderech traveler's prayer in Hebrew with translation
- [Explore the deeper side of Jewish prayer | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/explore-the-deeper-side-of-jewish-prayer): Weekly email newsletter exploring Jewish prayer and liturgy

## Grief, Mourning & Kaddish

- [The Mourner's Kaddish: A Memorial Prayer in Praise of God | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/article/kaddish-a-memorial-prayer-in-praise-of-god): Reference guide to Mourner's Kaddish prayer in Aramaic and its meaning
- [Say Kaddish Online With MJL | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/article/join-a-daily-online-kaddish-minyan-with-mjl): Guide to joining daily online Mourner's Kaddish minyan for grief support
- [Timeline of Jewish Mourning | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/article/timeline-of-jewish-mourning): Guide to Jewish mourning rituals including shiva and funeral customs
- [A Jewish Journey Through Grief | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/grief-mourning-signup): Email series on Jewish grief rituals including Kaddish, shiva, and bereavement
- [A Good End Podcast | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/landing/__agoodend): Podcast on Jewish end-of-life care, death traditions, and dying conversations

## Jewish Traditions & Reference

- [Jewish Calendar | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/article/calendar-of-major-jewish-holidays): Reference guide to major Jewish holidays with dates and observances
- [The Jewish Denominations | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/article/the-jewish-denominations): Reference on Reform, Orthodox, and Conservative Judaism movements
- [Is There a Jewish Afterlife? | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/article/life-after-death): Reference on Jewish theology regarding afterlife and World to Come

## Food & Community

- [The Nosher | My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/the-nosher): Jewish food and recipe content including Passover dishes and cooking tips

## Support & Giving

- [Donate to Support My Jewish Learning](https://www.myjewishlearning.com/support): Donation page for 70 Faces Media's Jewish learning platform

## Optional Resources
